ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution with a very low global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to water surface reflections and localized surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes with no large-scale white mottling; localized micro-clusters of higher-intensity pixels (grey/white) are visible near the central median notch and scattered across the central surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; multiple distinct pixel-level peaks and valleys with larger indentations localized on the right lobe trailing edge relative to the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips; distal tips exhibit a sharp upward orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured tan/brown pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several small, isolated white circular points on the lower central ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe (vertical orientation) and near the left side of the median notch (diagonal orientation).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured biological encrustation clusters at the distal tips; irregular trailing edge margins consistent with mechanical wear or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small protrusion is visible on the leading edge profile of the left lobe against the sky background.
